calculation_method: The FIA starting grid lists Antonelli P10 and explicitly cites the three-place Austrian collision penalty; his qualifying result was P7, so the realized grid loss is exactly three positions.
assumptions: The finish and points effect is not estimable. The wet race included tyre changes, VSC and Safety Car periods, a separate Hadjar collision, and Antonelli's retirement after 23 laps; moving his start back to P7 does not mechanically determine a finish.
